  "decision-reconcile-carton-short-shipment-credit": "WITH shortages AS (
  SELECT i.line_id, c.report_id, MAX(i.billed_qty - c.accepted_qty, 0) AS missing_qty,
         i.unit_cents, COALESCE(c.posted_cents, 0) AS posted_cents
  FROM invoice_line AS i
  JOIN carton_close AS c ON c.line_id = i.line_id
), claims AS (
  SELECT line_id, report_id, missing_qty, missing_qty * unit_cents - posted_cents AS claim_cents
  FROM shortages
)
SELECT line_id, report_id, missing_qty, claim_cents
FROM claims
WHERE claim_cents > 0
ORDER BY claim_cents DESC, line_id ASC",
  "decision-reconcile-course-charges-at-close": "WITH flip_counts AS (
  SELECT charge_id, COUNT(*) AS flip_count
  FROM bill_flip
  WHERE flip_min <= 60
  GROUP BY charge_id
), charges AS (
  SELECT c.table_code, c.face_cents,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(f.flip_count, 0) % 2 = 1 THEN -c.face_cents ELSE 0 END AS adjustment
  FROM course_charge AS c
  LEFT JOIN flip_counts AS f ON f.charge_id = c.charge_id
  WHERE c.post_min <= 60
)
SELECT table_code, SUM(face_cents) AS gross_cents, SUM(adjustment) AS adjustment_cents,
       SUM(face_cents + adjustment) AS net_cents
FROM charges
GROUP BY table_code
ORDER BY table_code ASC",
  "decision-reconcile-display-ad-shortfall-credits": "WITH posted AS (
  SELECT insertion_id, SUM(delta_cents) AS posted_net_cents
  FROM credit_movement
  WHERE entry_state = 'posted'
  GROUP BY insertion_id
), allowances AS (
  SELECT s.insertion_id, MAX(s.booked_lines - s.usable_lines, 0) * s.rate_cents AS gross_cents,
         COALESCE(p.posted_net_cents, 0) AS posted_net_cents, s.source_id
  FROM inspection_slip AS s
  LEFT JOIN posted AS p ON p.insertion_id = s.insertion_id
)
SELECT insertion_id, gross_cents, posted_net_cents, gross_cents - posted_net_cents AS due_cents, source_id
FROM allowances
WHERE gross_cents > posted_net_cents
ORDER BY due_cents DESC, insertion_id ASC",
  "decision-reconcile-gallery-scan-page-counts": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT page_no, sheet_kind, tally, source_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY page_no, sheet_kind ORDER BY revision_no DESC, source_id COLLATE BINARY ASC) AS rn
  FROM desk_sheet
), pages AS (
  SELECT g.page_no, g.exported_rows, f.tally - s.tally AS required_rows,
         f.source_id AS frames_source, s.source_id AS slates_source
  FROM gallery_footer AS g
  JOIN ranked AS f ON f.page_no = g.page_no AND f.sheet_kind = 'frames' AND f.rn = 1
  JOIN ranked AS s ON s.page_no = g.page_no AND s.sheet_kind = 'slates' AND s.rn = 1
)
SELECT page_no, exported_rows, required_rows, required_rows - exported_rows AS missing_rows, frames_source, slates_source
FROM pages
WHERE required_rows <> exported_rows
ORDER BY page_no ASC"

         i.unit_cents, COALESCE(c.posted_cents, 0) AS posted_cents

  SELECT line_id, report_id, missing_qty, missing_qty * unit_cents - posted_cents AS claim_cents
